name: SPEED LIMIT
spec: white vertical rectangle with black legend SPEED LIMIT above large black numerals 55
meaning: The maximum legal speed under ideal conditions.

snippets.back: Local authorities or the state transportation department may alter speed limits.
A posted speed limit is the speed allowed under normal conditions, and a sign reading SPEED LIMIT thirty means thirty miles an hour is the top speed in that area.
Observe posted speed limits and reduce speed as driving conditions require.
Road conditions, traffic flow and the number of crashes are used to set a road's proper speed limit, and you must obey every posted limit.
Pay particular attention to speed limits near people in the street, schools and neighborhoods with children.
A school-zone speed limit applies during the hours the sign shows, and it may also be displayed on a lighted sign with flashing amber lights.
Check the speedometer frequently to confirm that you remain within the speed limit.
When no limit is posted, the speed limit is fifteen miles per hour as you approach a school crosswalk.
